label: BuddiHex Rotator v1.7
info:
Native FlowFuse Dashboard 2 flow for mdannhardt/rotatorControllerESP8266.
Uses the firmware's PST-compatible <AZIMUTH> and <PST><STOP> UDP commands.
Edit the CONFIG function and set the controller IP.
Callsign lookup tries QRZ first, then checks AD1C Country Files (CTY.DAT) for an exact call or the longest matching prefix.
The panel's UPDATE COUNTRY LIST button refreshes the file from the Win-Test mirror. The first fallback also downloads it if needed.
The cache defaults to ~/.node-red/buddihex-cty.dat. Set BUDDIHEX_DXCC_FILE to an absolute path in a writable directory if using a different user directory. The DXCC Function uses Node.js built-in fs and path via Function node modules.


The full dashboard panel displays the compass and all controls inline.

In CONFIG choose direct (ESP8266 UDP) or remote (Pi bridge or standard Hamlib rotctld TCP). Use remoteHost and remotePort for either TCP endpoint. The flow automatically detects Pi bridge support and enables its live motion feedback and Set North when available.

name: Dashboard 2 — full Rotator Controller
info: R6 preserves the flows-19/20 movement and calibration functions unchanged. Separate adapters isolate feedback from commands and targets. Run only one rotator tab. SET NORTH requires the antenna already physically pointing north and stopped.
